name: NeedsAttentionRankingV1
rules: owner supplies attention_class and owner_severity; LLD-11 does not reinterpret business severity
exact duplicate items with same dedupe key and identical semantic payload collapse to one
same dedupe key with conflicting semantic payload is provider contract failure
null due time sorts after a known due time inside the same class/severity
pagination keyset uses the complete sort tuple and query filter/window fingerprint
resolved/non-actionable items must be excluded by owner provider before ranking
